editorial:
Imagine going back to the house where you grew up, only to find that your family secrets are still hiding in the walls. You follow three siblings who are all a bit weird in their own way. They haven't seen each other in years, but they come back together to try and fix their relationship. The vibe is a mix of a family reunion and a mystery movie. You get to see them argue, laugh, and slowly realize that their parents didn't just vanish by accident. It feels like a cozy but tense trip down memory lane that keeps you wondering what is actually going on.

The acting is the best part because the siblings feel like real people you might know. The plot moves along well, though some parts are a bit slow. If you like stories about family secrets, you will love this. Just grab some popcorn and settle in for a wild ride.
endingExplained: You find out that the parents never actually left the house. They had a huge fight and ended up dying in a hidden basement room that the kids never found. The eldest sister knew the truth all along but kept it secret to protect her younger siblings from the trauma. In the final scene, they all hug and decide to sell the house to start their lives over without the lies.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves family mysteries and emotional character stories.
